queries_run: Amazon.com distribution channel shift agentic shopping business model 2026
Amazon Prime subscription platform marketplace transition 2026 third-party sellers advertising

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 列示競爭者包含搜尋引擎、比價網站、社群、虛擬助理等線上與 app 發現商品的管道，含透過人工智慧者；行銷成本隨流量來源競爭與通路組合變動。
findings.excerpt: web search engines, comparison shopping websites, social networks, web portals, virtual assistants, and other online and app-based means of discovering, using, or acquiring goods and services, either directly or in collaboration with other retailers, including through artificial intelligence

findings.claim: 第三方賣家占付費銷量比重降至 60%（2024 Q4 為 62%），自營零售單位量成長快於第三方，第三方絕對量仍增加。
findings.source: Canopy Management 分析 Amazon Q1 2026 財報
findings.excerpt: third-party seller share of paid units dropped to 60%, down from 62% in Q4 2024

findings.claim: 廣告服務營收 2026 Q1 為 172 億美元、年增 24%；2025 全年廣告營收 686 億美元。
findings.excerpt: advertising services revenue grew 24% year over year to $17.2 billion for the quarter

findings.claim: Amazon 於 2026 年 5 月將 Rufus 併入並更名 Alexa for Shopping，整合進搜尋列與廣告變現體系；Q2 2026 財報電話會議稱其活躍用戶年增近一倍（搜尋摘要轉述，未取得原文）。
findings.source: WebSearch 摘要彙整（Modern Retail／Retail Dive／Forrester 等）

channel_business_model_shift.note: 訂閱化／D2C 轉型無查得來源；Prime 訂閱平台轉型 2026 查無報導。

clues.claim: Alexa for Shopping 活躍用戶年增近一倍，AI 購物代理整合於 Amazon 自有生態系
